criteria: Description clearly explains the expected behavior
Acceptance criteria are present and testable (observable pass/fail)
No unresolved dependencies or open questions
High Quality.note: Minor edge-case questions (e.g., expired codes, rounding) do not downgrade an item. Use High Quality when the main success and failure paths have testable criteria. Use Needs Clarification only when behavior is unclear, criteria are missing, or requirements conflict.

criteria: A required work item component is missing (e.g., no acceptance criteria, no repro steps for a Bug)
Requirements are unclear, conflicting, or ambiguous
Changes authorization, authentication, or security behavior
Data migration/schema change or potential breaking API change
Requires Manual Review.note: The AI only flags these and routes to a human. It does not assess further.
